definition: Exported text messages from sender s_ana in conv-garden whose text contains the literal 'water' (ASCII letters case-insensitive).
filters: source synthetic:demo-account; conversation conv-garden; sender s_ana; placeholders excluded
period: local dates 2026-03-01 through 2026-03-03 inclusive, as the half-open interval [2026-03-01, 2026-03-04)
missing_data: Counts only messages present in the imported synthetic export at the pinned revision; messages missing from the export are not counted and a count is not a number of real watering events.
